skill.displayName: A股涨停板龙虎榜深度研判+财富密码策略

llm.summary: The skill is mostly a disclosed A-share report generator, but it tells users/integrators to set up recurring unattended cron execution without enough safety controls.

dimensions.detail: The skill may use configured westock/IMA data access and generate local report files, which fits the purpose, but recurring unattended operation could repeatedly use credentials, network, and writable directories.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install commands copy skill files into OpenClaw and MiMo skill directories, which is expected for installation; the hardcoded GitHub push target is unusual and should not be followed blindly.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation language is finance/report oriented and mostly on-topic, but some trigger phrases are broad enough to invoke the workflow for adjacent market-research requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and README.md explicitly describe registering a durable cron task for trading-day report generation, but do not provide concrete scoping, execution identity, pinned revision, logging, limits, or removal instructions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, data sources, generated HTML/PDF/PPTX artifacts, and financial disclaimer are coherent with a Chinese A-share research-report skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a Chinese A-share report-generation workflow. Do not enable the durable cron option unless you explicitly review the exact command, account, working directory, data credentials, output location, logs, and removal procedure. Avoid pushing to the hardcoded GitHub remote unless it is intentionally your repository or you have replaced it with your own target.
llm.findings:
[T06] unexpected: Accepted as a material review concern: the cron instruction is disclosed and report-related, but durable unattended execution is under-specified and expands a one-time skill into persistent scheduled activity.
[RA2] expected: Downgraded for the install-directory examples because copying skill files into normal skill locations is expected installation behavior, not unauthorized persistence by itself; the separate durable cron text remains the real persistence concern.
[SQP-1] expected: Partially accepted as a scoping note: the triggers are related to A-share report generation, but some phrases are broad and could activate the workflow for adjacent finance prompts.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language content matches the A-share/Chinese-market purpose and is not by itself a security concern.
[AE4] expected: The inspected files contain Chinese text, punctuation, Greek alpha, arrows, and emoji; I found no artifact-backed evidence of obfuscation, hidden commands, secrets, or prompt injection.
